about_the_game:
Paw Party Demo: Your AI Social Party Paradise!

Paw Party Demo is an AI-powered social party game community preview. Here, players can experience core online party games and enjoy party fun with AI companions.

Differences between Demo and Full Version

Demo version only includes:

  • Social party game features

  • Basic AI companion interaction

  • Online party game experience

Full version will additionally include:

  • Pet raising system

  • Life simulation gameplay

  • Deeper AI companion bonding system

Demo Features

  • Play social games with AI companions

In the Demo, you can experience party games and online board games. Lively, warm AI companions bring you a unique party interaction experience.

  • Game Highlights

✨ AI instantly generates topics and comments, with surprises constantly upgrading!

- Unmatched Social Gaming with AI Companions

In Paw Party, you can enjoy a unique experience playing party games and online tabletop games with lively AI companions. These AI friends bring warmth, understanding, and energy, creating a social dynamic like no other.

- A more authentic AI companionship experience

Our AI NPCs are more than just sidekicks; they’re your pets and companions. Chat with them, deepen your bond, and enjoy a friend who’s there for you anytime, anywhere, making every game feel special!

- Game Features

✨ AI-Generated Challenges and Comments, Surprises at Every Turn!

🏆 Score Battles Bring the Hype, Emoji Interactions Bring the Fun!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains trivia questions and references to sexual acts, or adult themes in a humorous, or entertainment context. Content includes text-based descriptions, innuendos, or discussions of sexual topics (e.g., reproductive health, relationships, or adult humor). There are no explicit visual depictions of sexual acts, nudity, or graphic imagery. The game is intended for mature audiences.
